name: How long does it take to repair a dripping faucet?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a dripping faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most dripping faucet repairs can be completed relatively quickly, often within 30 minutes to an hour, depending on the complexity of the faucet and the specific problem. Replacing a simple washer or O-ring is usually a fast process. However, if the issue involves a more intricate cartridge replacement, corrosion, or requires accessing hard-to-reach components, the repair might take longer. Our plumbers work efficiently to restore your faucet's function as soon as possible.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most dripping faucet repairs take 30 minutes to an hour, depending on complexity and the parts needed for replacement.
